scripts.dev: bun run --filter @casesync/api dev & bun run --filter @casesync/web dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @casesync/api build && bun run --filter @casesync/web build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @casesync/api test && bun run --filter @casesync/web test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: bun run --filter @casesync/api test && bun run --filter @casesync/web test
scripts.test:integration: cd apps/api && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 bun test tests/integration
scripts.test:coverage: cd apps/api && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov && cd ../.. && bun run scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check:ci && bun run typecheck:api && bun run typecheck:web && bun run test:unit && bun run build
